name: Hor Kew Corporation Limited
summary: Hor Kew Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, provides various integrated construction related products and services in Singapore. Its Property Investment and Development segment is involved in the development, sale, and leasing of residential, commercial, and industrial properties. The company's Construction segment constructs residential, institutional, industrial, and commercial properties as a primary contractor. Its Prefabrication segment designs, manufactures, and sells prestressed and reinforced concrete building components, as well as prefabricated architectural metal components. The company also rents machinery. Hor Kew Corporation Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Singapore.
